name: Red-capped white-spotted toadstools 013
prompt: a small cluster of woodland mushrooms with rounded caps and pale stems growing from leaf litter, red-capped white-spotted toadstools, lightly snow-dusted, tiny, only ankle-high, completely unlit, no glow, no light sources, no self-emission

placement.note: ONE SCENERY PIXEL IS ONE PLAYER PIXEL. world_px_height IS the art's own alpha bbox height, so scenery is placed into the world at 1:1 exactly as the avatar is (setScale(1)) and the two share one pixel grid. The CAMERA still zooms the whole scene — that is uniform and correct; what must never happen is scenery being resampled on its own, against the player. world_height_m is what the art reads as beside a 87px character; declared_height_m is what it was once declared to be, and a gap between them means the ART is the wrong size.

LIT_1.glow_concept: bioluminescent gills casting light from under the caps

motion.description: This is the same picture in every frame. ONLY the cyan light under the caps brightens a little and returns. It is lit and clearly visible in every single frame, including the first. It is at its brightest in the MIDDLE of the animation and back to exactly its first-frame brightness and colour at the end. It never fades out and is never dimmer at the end than at the start. Everything else in the picture is copied from the first frame exactly, pixel for pixel, unchanged in shape, size, position and colour. No outline anywhere is redrawn. The last frame matches the first frame exactly, so the loop joins.

light.reference: the spawn bonfire is 1.0 (radius 7); strength 0 is no light
